title: Radial Projectively Induced Canonical Kähler Metrics: Rigidity and Classification
summary: We study radial Kähler metrics on domains of $\mathbb{C}^n$, $n\geq 2$, admitting a Kähler immersion into a finite- or infinite-dimensional complex projective space. We classify those with constant non-negative scalar curvature: up to a linear change of coordinates, they are positive integer multiples of the Fubini-Study metric, the flat metric, or, in complex dimension two, generalized Burns-Simanca metrics.
